_doc: Central tuning knobs for the autoresearch loop (Phase 3+4). Read by the optimizer-seed scripts; every knob has an env override (for tests) that takes precedence over this file, which takes precedence over the script default. See dict/configs/optimizer-seed/scripts/tunables.py.
_L2_THRESHOLD_doc: Cost-cascade gate (PLAN.md App.B / IMPLEMENTATION.md §4): a bundle's L2 aggregate must exceed this to pay for the L3 (real-bot) leg. Tuned to 0.7 — above it sit the proven configs (baseline 0.80, champion 0.889) and below it sit L2 failures, so only viable configs cascade. Env override: GAIA_L2_THRESHOLD.
_L3_ENABLED_doc: Master switch for the L3 (axi real-bot) cascade leg. false = L2-only scoring (default; no Discord round-trip, no instance needed). true requires a booted axi_test.py instance named in soul-benchmarks/config.yaml (axi_test_instance_name). Env override: GAIA_L3_ENABLED.
_UCB_C_doc: UCB exploration weight for sample-config (argmax aggregate + c*stderr). Higher = more exploration of under-evaluated bundles. Env override: AUTORES_UCB_C.
_FANOUT_K_doc: How many run-experiment lineages the orchestrator spawns per epoch (orchestrator.json INIT_FANOUT_K -> inner loop spawns lineage-1..K, then JOIN waits on all K). K=1 reproduces the old serial one-lineage-per-epoch behavior. Env override: AUTORES_FANOUT_K.
_SAMPLE_STRATEGY_doc: Parent-sampling strategy for sample-config/ucb_pick.py. 'thompson' (default) = weighted sampling from each scored bundle's Normal(aggregate, stderr) posterior, argmax of draws (weights toward high scores but stays stochastic so the K-way fan-out is diverse). 'argmax' = old deterministic UCB argmax(aggregate + c*stderr). Env override: AUTORES_SAMPLE_STRATEGY.
_IDEA_STALE_SECONDS_doc: How long a claimed idea may sit unterminated before ideas.py's fold reaps it back to `future`. Defaults to orchestrator.json's 21600s JOIN timeout — a lineage cannot outlive its own join, so an older claim is definitionally dead. Without this a lineage that dies holding an idea strands it forever, which is exactly what the legacy `[~]` marks did. Env override: AUTORES_IDEA_STALE_SECONDS.
_IDEA_GEN_MIN_doc: Minimum distinct hypotheses the mutator must generate at mutate-config §2c before filtering down to the promising subset it deposits. Large enough that filtering is a real selection; small enough not to dominate the mutator's turn. Env override: AUTORES_IDEA_GEN_MIN.
_THOMPSON_SD_FLOOR_doc: Floor on a scored bundle's posterior sd (its stderr) for Thompson draws, so a 1-eval / zero-stderr bundle still gets exploration noise instead of collapsing to its mean. Env override: AUTORES_THOMPSON_SD_FLOOR. (SAMPLE_SEED is intentionally env-only via AUTORES_SAMPLE_SEED — tests/repro only; a fixed seed collapses the fan-out.)
